body.name: randomized minimax expected length
body.construction: \(D_{\mathrm{rand}}(\kappa)=\inf_{K:\,\inf_{\eta}\mathbb E_{P_{\eta,\kappa}}K(s,X,\{J:\theta(\eta)\in J\})\ge1-\alpha}\sup_{\eta}\mathbb E_{P_{\eta,\kappa}}\int_{\mathfrak I}\ell(J)K(s,X,dJ)\) over Markov kernels \(K\) on \(\mathfrak I\).
